create_VizSeqTaskConfigManager: create a VizSeqTaskConfigManager to manage task configuration with task name, description, metrics, and tokenization settings
create_VizSeqGlobalConfigManager: create a VizSeqGlobalConfigManager to manage global configuration including credential path settings
set_VizSeqTaskConfigManager_metrics: set metrics on a VizSeqTaskConfigManager with a list of valid scorer metric IDs
set_VizSeqTaskConfigManager_tokenization: set tokenization on a VizSeqTaskConfigManager to a valid tokenization method name
set_VizSeqGlobalConfigManager_g_cred_pat: set the global credential path on a VizSeqGlobalConfigManager
